items.t: Scott Creek condos and townhomes for sale

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Scott Creek?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 4 houses and 6 condos and townhomes listed in Scott Creek. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Scott Creek a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes had 33% on only 6 listed, too few to read as a market type. The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Scott Creek from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 3 houses and 7 condos and townhomes sold in Scott Creek over those 4 months; detached houses peaked in June with 2 sold and condos and townhomes peaked in August with 4 sold.

faq.q: How big is Scott Creek compared with the rest of Coquitlam?
faq.a: In September 2026, Scott Creek held 0.9% of the 425 detached houses listed in Coquitlam and 0.7% of the 806 condos and townhomes listed in Coquitlam.

faq.q: What mix of houses and condos is for sale in Scott Creek?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses made up 40.0% of the 10 homes listed in Scott Creek and condos and townhomes made up 60.0%; of the 2 that sold, houses were 0.0% and condos and townhomes 100.0%.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Scott Creek than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses was 2 in June and 4 in September 2026, too few (under 3) to call a rise or fall; condos and townhomes rose from 3 in June to 6 in September 2026 (+100.0%).
